name: Grotesque

bonuses.name: Power From Pain: Inured To Suffering
bonuses.text: If this Threat deals a Wound it gains +1 bonus dice to Determination Tests until the end of its next Turn.

bonuses.name: Lobotomized
bonuses.text: This Threat is barely sentient and acts out the will of its dark master relentlessly. It ignores abilities that target the mind and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 2 Fear Test.

determination: Insensible to Pain: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 7d6. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock
